item.title: [Ada Derana Biz English] Vietjet’s three-day 9.9 sale offers fares from USD90 on flights to Vietnam
item.description:
Vietjet is giving Sri Lankan travellers another reason to plan their next trip, with a three-day 9.9 sale featuring Eco tickets from USD90 one-way (inclusive of taxes and fees) and 22% off Deluxe base fares on its newly-launched Colombo–Ho Chi Minh City route.
The sale runs from 22:30 on 7 September to 21:30 on 10 September 2026 (Sri Lanka time), with the promotional Eco fares available across Vietnam domestic and international routes, while the Deluxe discount applies to international flights
